<title level="1" right="Background " pfs="Standard">[Deep-Sea Diver](/Backgrounds.aspx?ID=378)</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 44

</column>

The sapphire depths of the seas and the mysteries they hold beneath their surface have always piqued your interest. Your obsession with the ocean depths cannot be contained to one world alone, and you've read tomes and journals about the source of all water, everywhere, hoping to one day understand the watery secrets of the great unknown.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength
or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) skill, and the [Plane of Water Lore](/skills/lore) skill. You gain the [Underwater Marauder](/Feats.aspx?ID=858) skill feat.
